query: DELETE fe FROM funnel_events fe INNER JOIN ( SELECT MIN(id) as keep_id, sessionId FROM funnel_events WHERE eventType = 'quiz_start' GROUP BY sessionId HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) dups ON fe.sessionId = dups.sessionId AND fe.eventType = 'quiz_start' AND fe.id != dups.keep_id;
